messages:
samir: Quick heads-up — AWS private-offer intake needs a few new pieces for the listing: localized EULA (EN/FR/DE), pricing JSON for trial vs paid tiers, and the Offer ID to wire into our billing mapping. Legal wants the EULA drafts by EOD Fri.

jess (legal): Ack. I can start the EN -> FR/DE handoff with our translation vendor, but need the canonical EULA source. Is there a product-specific clause for Dedicated vs Hosted we should include?

andrew (product): Yes — add the Dedicated uptime SLA clause + dedicated data isolation blurb for the private offer. I'll paste the clause below. Use this exact snippet.

andrew (product): ```
Dedicated SLA: 99.9% uptime (monthly), isolated tenant storage, and regional data residency per customer config.
```

samir: Thanks. Also AWS asked for the pricing manifest as a single JSON they can ingest. Example they gave looks like: 
```
{
  "offer_id": "REDF-PO-2026-001",
  "plans": [
    {"sku": "rdw-trial-1", "price_per_hour": 0.0, "trial_days": 14},
    {"sku": "rdw-dedicated-small", "price_per_hour": 2.5, "commit_term": "monthly"}
  ]
}
```

samir: Can someone own populating that with correct SKUs and the Offer ID? AWS will reject if fields mismatch.

lia (ops): I can export the SKU list from the billing DB, but need to know which SKUs are included in the private-offer trial. Samir, do we default to the small dedicated pool or allow burst?

samir: For the private-offer trial use `rdw-trial-1` mapped to the small dedicated pool (no burst). We'll document burst as add-on in the paid plan.

jess (legal): Also: translations — please confirm the canonical EN EULA doc version. We should lock the doc id and version so translators pick the right file.

andrew: Canonical doc is `eula/redwood-inference-eula-v2.1.md`. Please use v2.1 — we cut v2.2 next sprint.

lia: I'll attach the SKU CSV in the partner drive and generate the initial pricing JSON. Who should review?

samir: Jess for legal text/clauses, Andrew for SKU/pricing accuracy, and I'll do final partner sign-off.

jess: ETA — I can get EN -> FR/DE vendor kickoff today, but need the locked EN doc by 3pm PT.

andrew: I will lock the EULA doc in the repo by 2:30pm PT and push the commit link here.

deploy-bot: Deployment note: marketplace manifest pipeline will pick up `marketplace/pricing/*.json` on merge. CI checks will validate offer_id uniqueness.

lia: OK creating a draft PR: https://git.redwood.internal/marketplace/pricing/pulls/142 — includes CSV -> JSON transform and a placeholder Offer ID.

samir: Perfect. Action items: 
- andrew: lock EN EULA (by 2:30pm PT)
- jess: start translation vendor & confirm legal clauses in localized EULAs (by EOD Fri)
- lia: export SKUs + open PR with JSON draft (in progress)
- samir: final review and offer_id assignment before we submit to AWS (target Mon)

jess: One more ask from legal: we need to check regional tax handling for the trial — does the marketplace take tax or do we? Anyone with billing context?

lia: Marketplace typically handles VAT in EU storefronts but we need to confirm SKU tax classification. I'll ping billing and loop back.

samir: Cool. If billing confirms no blocking tax issue, we'll submit Monday. If we hit tax gating, postpone by 48hrs. :thumbsup:

andrew: Will follow up in the PR with the dedicated-plan metadata (cpu/gpu, ram, region list).

jess: Thanks all — looping back once translations are kicked off. :white_check_mark:
